killedBy: createNamespacedStorage: developer clear() removes ONLY the developer keys, and leaves every production key
why: Resets EVERY key instead of the developer namespace, so Reset Developer Data wipes the player's real campaign, stats, achievements and customization -- the single most damaging thing this pane could do, under a button whose label promises the opposite. Issue #249's third criterion is exactly this: "Reset Developer Data cannot remove or rewrite any production key." The scoping is structural -- `createNamespacedStorage`'s developer `clear()` walks only the prefixed names -- and this entry is what stops that being true only until someone reaches for the base storage, which is one identifier away.
